sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive leadership dominates as Consumer Defensive sustains top-tier performance while zero sectors demonstrate all-green breadth across all timeframes.

Defensive sectors are firmly leading the market, anchored by Consumer Defensive holding sustained strength in the top 3 across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons. Healthcare also displays strong backing with an elevated momentum score, while Energy retains the top year-to-date position despite more moderate momentum. 

Rotation remains muted across the board, with only minor 5-session shifts favoring Industrials and Utilities over Basic Materials and Financials. Meanwhile, growth and cyclical areas like Communication Services and Basic Materials continue to fade into the bottom ranks with the weakest momentum profiles.

## Strength
- **Consumer Defensive Sustained:** Stands as the sole sector with sustained strength across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month rank windows, carrying a momentum score of 0.850 and holding rank 2 year-to-date.
- **Top YTD Leadership:** Energy maintains the #1 year-to-date rank with a 0.550 momentum score, followed by Healthcare holding rank 3 with a strong 0.733 momentum score.
- **Zero All-Green Breadth:** Overall market breadth is entirely absent at 0 of 11 groups positive across the week, month, quarter, half-year, and year-to-date periods.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Momentum Leaders:** Consumer Defensive (0.850), Healthcare (0.733), and Consumer Cyclical (0.600) register the highest momentum scores across the sectors.
- **Momentum Laggards:** Communication Services sits at the bottom with a 0.167 momentum score (rank 11), followed closely by Basic Materials at 0.200 (rank 9).
- **5-Session Movers:** Industrials and Utilities each gained +1 spot to reach ranks 6 (momentum 0.417) and 8 (momentum 0.533), respectively, while Basic Materials and Financials each dropped -1 spot to ranks 9 and 7.

## Divergences
- **Consumer Cyclical Disconnect:** Consumer Cyclical carries the third-highest momentum score on the board (0.600) despite a deeply lagging year-to-date position at rank 10.
- **Energy Rank vs. Velocity:** Energy maintains the #1 year-to-date rank, yet its momentum score of 0.550 trails behind Consumer Defensive (0.850), Healthcare (0.733), and Consumer Cyclical (0.600).
- **Technology Weakness:** Technology remains weighed down in the bottom half of momentum scores at 0.483, lagging its year-to-date standing of rank 4.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Broad market breadth remains exceptionally tight with only 3 of 144 groups all-green, while defensive retail and housing-related cyclicals lead and materials and healthcare names fade sharply.

Leadership remains concentrated in consumer staples and select cyclicals, with Discount Stores (momentum 0.896) and Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances (momentum 0.894) demonstrating rare multi-timeframe strength alongside Insurance - Reinsurance (momentum 0.873) and Lodging (momentum 0.861). Capital is rapidly fleeing pockets of consumer discretionary and healthcare, punctuated by steep multi-session rank collapses in Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries (-65 spots) and Healthcare Plans (-43 spots).

At the same time, rotation is visible as beaten-down tech and industrial components begin to push higher from weak baselines. Early-stage momentum is forming across Electronic Components (+15 spots to rank 51) and Semiconductors (+13 spots), even as former leaders like Medical Care Facilities and Luxury Goods show early signs of momentum fatigue.

## Strength
- **Narrow all-green breadth:** Only 3 of 144 industry groups are positive across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD frames: Discount Stores (momentum 0.90), Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances (momentum 0.89), and Conglomerates (momentum 0.70).
- **Sustained top-quartile leaders:** Consistent 1-, 3-, and 6-month performance is anchored by Discount Stores, Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances, Insurance - Reinsurance, REIT - Hotel & Motel, Lodging, Security & Protection Services, Medical Distribution, and Insurance - Property & Casualty.
- **Top absolute momentum:** Discount Stores (0.896, YTD rank 20), Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances (0.894, YTD rank 33), and Insurance - Reinsurance (0.873, YTD rank 9) hold the highest momentum scores across all groups.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Fastest short-term gainers:** Engineering & Construction jumped +17 spots (rank 66, momentum 0.52), matching a +17 spot gain by Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances (rank 33), while Conglomerates climbed +16 spots (rank 55, momentum 0.70).
- **Severe 5-day drops:** Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries plummeted 65 positions to rank 103 (momentum 0.43), while Healthcare Plans plunged 43 spots to rank 60 (momentum 0.33), and Chemicals dropped 22 spots to rank 40.
- **Persistent laggards:** Deepest momentum weakness is concentrated in Solar (0.023, YTD rank 143), Uranium (0.024, YTD rank 142), Other Precious Metals & Mining (0.041, YTD rank 140), and Gambling (0.051, YTD rank 144).

## Divergences
- **Fading high-momentum groups:** Despite strong baseline profiles, Medical Care Facilities (momentum 0.69) slipped 9 spots over the past 5 sessions, Luxury Goods (momentum 0.60) dropped 8 spots, and Medical Distribution (momentum 0.78) declined 5 spots.
- **Emerging early-stage turnarounds:** Fast rank gains are colliding with weak momentum baselines in Electronic Components (+15 spots in 5d, momentum 0.50), Apparel Retail (+13 spots, momentum 0.48), and Semiconductors (+13 spots, momentum 0.44).
- **Industrial inflection points:** Building Products & Equipment and Metal Fabrication each gained 10 spots over 5 sessions despite middling momentum scores of 0.47 and 0.51, respectively.
